Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Intern position at IPPF EN. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, social media, and website management, I am excited about the opportunity to support your communications activities and contribute to advancing gender equality and SRHR.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I have also developed my own project, mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and social media integration. I am proficient in Canva, including video editing, and have strong writing skills. I am comfortable with WordPress and have experience with analytics tools like Google Analytics and Search Console.

I am deeply committed to gender equality and human rights, and I am eager to apply my skills to support IPPF EN's campaigns and projects. I am a quick learner, well-organized, and thrive in multicultural environments. I am based in Belgium and have the right to work here.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Communications Intern position at IPPF EN. With a background in digital marketing, content creation, and web management, and a deep commitment to gender equality and human rights, I am eager to contribute to your mission of advancing sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) in Europe and beyond.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed skills directly relevant to this position. I manage on-page SEO for client websites, write keyword-targeted blog content, and build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. I am proficient in Canva, including video editing, and have experience creating social media assets and integrating social media into websites. My work on mirook.com, a project I developed from scratch, involved implementing structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits, as well as managing content and social media integration. This experience has given me a strong foundation in digital communications and storytelling.

I am particularly drawn to IPPF EN's work on the Countdown 2030 Europe and Safeguarding Gender Equality projects. I am a proactive and creative individual with excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. I thrive in multicultural environments and am committed to the values of diversity, inclusion, and youth participation. I am fluent in English, with native Turkish and intermediate Dutch, and I have the right to work in Belgium.

I am excited about the opportunity to support your communications activities, from creating engaging content to managing social media and websites. I am a quick learner and eager to contribute to impactful campaigns that promote gender equality and SRHR.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content creation. At Episto, I run on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and manage full-cycle WordPress site builds and maintenance. On my own project (mirook.com), I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Experienced in social media coordination, content management, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Social Media: social media content creation & integration (Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook)
- Design & Tools: Canva (including video editing), WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, AI-assisted content tools
- SEO & Analytics: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)

- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score
